fluff.overview: The CCAF fields conventional infantry in larger numbers than its limited industrial base might suggest, drawing on the Confederation's deep tradition of citizens' militia service. Capellan soldiers learn to fight with fewer resources and less support than their counterparts in wealthier states, compensating with resourcefulness and ideological commitment. Mechanized wheeled platoons balance speed and infantry presence, using armored wheeled transports to move troops quickly along the Confederation's road networks. They sacrifice the cross-country capability of tracked vehicles for faster transit between defensive positions. Flamer sections carry man-portable incendiary weapons that are devastating in close quarters and against fortified positions, though the short range and hazardous fuel supply make flamer duty one of the most dangerous assignments in the platoon.
